title: MIN of a column ignores BLANK: over BLANK, 3 and 10 it is 3
query: EVALUATE ROW ( "r", CALCULATE ( MIN ( Nums[N] ), Nums[Id] IN { 2, 3, 5 } ) )

source.quote: The result is blank in case there are no rows in the table with a non-blank value
source.supports: MIN ( table[column] ) is MINX over the table, and only non-blank values take part

derivation: Nums[N] by Id: -5 (1), BLANK (2), 3 (3), -1 (4), 10 (5). The filter keeps Ids 2, 3, 5: BLANK, 3, 10. MIN of a column is MINX over its rows and skips BLANK: the minimum of 3 and 10 is 3. If BLANK counted as 0 the result would be 0 or BLANK.
